description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git's handling of line endings and file attributes related to CRLF and LF conversions. It contains functions for setting up test files, modifying gitattributes, checking file statuses, and running multiple test scenarios involving different configurations of core.autocrlf and core.eol, as well as various combinations of line endings and binary content.

methods.name: compare_files
methods.description: Compares two files after normalizing line endings and other content transformations to check for equivalence.

methods.name: compare_ws_file
methods.description: Compares two files with special handling of specific patterns and character transformations, used for whitespace and encoding checks.

methods.name: create_gitattributes
methods.description: Creates or updates a .gitattributes file with specified attributes for testing different line ending behaviors.

methods.name: create_NNO_MIX_files
methods.description: Creates a set of test files with various line endings and attributes to simulate different working directory states.

methods.name: check_warning
methods.description: Checks for expected warning messages when files are committed with different attributes and reproduces the expected warning output.

methods.name: commit_check_warn
methods.description: Performs a series of commits with specific attribute configurations to test warnings and file states.

methods.name: commit_chk_wrnNNO
methods.description: Sets up test files, modifies attributes, and commits files with specific line ending configurations, checking for expected warnings.

methods.name: commit_MIX_chkwrn
methods.description: Tests the handling of mixed line endings in files during commit and checks for appropriate warnings.

methods.name: stats_ascii
methods.description: Returns ASCII representation of line ending styles based on input parameters, used for displaying test status.

methods.name: attr_ascii
methods.description: Converts attributes and options to a string representation indicating text, end-of-line settings, or invalid states.

methods.name: check_files_in_repo
methods.description: Checks that the files in the repository match expected contents with specific line endings and attributes.

methods.name: check_in_repo_NNO
methods.description: Checks files in the repo with Non-Normalized in the repo (NNO) states against expected outputs.

methods.name: checkout_files
methods.description: Performs checkout operations with various configurations, compares checked-out files against expected states and line endings.
